name: Agent-S
description: Simular AI 开源 GUI / Computer-Use Agent 框架，支持像人一样操作电脑界面，适合桌面自动化和 GUI Agent 实验。

methods.name: venv 安装（推荐）
methods.command: python3 -m venv "$HOME/.agent-s-venv" && "$HOME/.agent-s-venv/bin/python" -m pip install -U pip && "$HOME/.agent-s-venv/bin/pip" install -U gui-agents && mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" "$HOME/.agent-s" && ln -sf "$HOME/.agent-s-venv/bin/agent_s" "$HOME/.local/bin/agent_s" && if command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then brew list tesseract >/dev/null 2>&1 || brew install tesseract; else echo '未检测到 Homebrew，请按系统环境手动安装 Tesseract OCR。'; fi

methods.name: pip 用户级安装
methods.command: python3 -m pip install --user -U gui-agents && if command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then brew list tesseract >/dev/null 2>&1 || brew install tesseract; else echo '未检测到 Homebrew，请按系统环境手动安装 Tesseract OCR。'; fi

update.command: if [ -x "$HOME/.agent-s-venv/bin/pip" ]; then "$HOME/.agent-s-venv/bin/pip" install -U gui-agents; else python3 -m pip install --user -U gui-agents; fi

post_install.description: 创建 Agent-S 配置模板
post_install.command: mkdir -p "$HOME/.agent-s" && if [ ! -f "$HOME/.agent-s/agent-s.env" ]; then printf '%s\n' '# Agent-S optional environment template' 'export AGENT_S_ENGINE_PARAMS="provider=<provider>,model=<model>,base_url=<base_url>,api_key=<api_key>"' 'export AGENT_S_GROUNDING_PARAMS="provider=<provider>,model=<model>,base_url=<base_url>,api_key=<api_key>"' '# export AGENT_S_ENABLE_LOCAL_CODE_EXECUTION=1  # 高风险：确认隔离环境后再启用' > "$HOME/.agent-s/agent-s.env"; fi
echo 'Agent-S 已安装。先编辑 ~/.agent-s/agent-s.env 配置主模型和 grounding model。常用入口: agent_s --help。不要在未隔离的生产目录启用本地代码执行。'

operations.view: cat "$HOME/.agent-s/agent-s.env" 2>/dev/null || echo '配置模板不存在，请先安装 Agent-S'
reset: printf '%s\n' '# Agent-S optional environment template' 'export AGENT_S_ENGINE_PARAMS="provider=<provider>,model=<model>,base_url=<base_url>,api_key=<api_key>"' 'export AGENT_S_GROUNDING_PARAMS="provider=<provider>,model=<model>,base_url=<base_url>,api_key=<api_key>"' '# export AGENT_S_ENABLE_LOCAL_CODE_EXECUTION=1  # 高风险：确认隔离环境后再启用' > "$HOME/.agent-s/agent-s.env"

commands.start: bash -lc 'if [ -f "$HOME/.agent-s/agent-s.env" ]; then . "$HOME/.agent-s/agent-s.env"; fi; if command -v agent_s >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec agent_s --help; else exec "$HOME/.agent-s-venv/bin/agent_s" --help; fi'
commands.help: bash -lc 'if command -v agent_s >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec agent_s --help; else exec "$HOME/.agent-s-venv/bin/agent_s" --help; fi'
commands.version: if [ -x "$HOME/.agent-s-venv/bin/python" ]; then "$HOME/.agent-s-venv/bin/python" -m pip show gui-agents 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^Version: //p'; else python3 -m pip show gui-agents 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^Version: //p' || echo '未安装'; fi

status_check.name: 检查 agent_s 命令
status_check.command: if command -v agent_s >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "PATH中找到: $(command -v agent_s)"; elif [ -x "$HOME/.agent-s-venv/bin/agent_s" ]; then echo "venv中找到: $HOME/.agent-s-venv/bin/agent_s"; else echo '未安装'; fi

status_check.name: 检查 gui-agents 包
status_check.command: if [ -x "$HOME/.agent-s-venv/bin/python" ]; then "$HOME/.agent-s-venv/bin/python" -m pip show gui-agents 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^Version: /gui-agents /p'; else python3 -m pip show gui-agents 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^Version: /gui-agents /p' || echo '未安装'; fi

status_check.name: 检查 Tesseract OCR
status_check.command: command -v tesseract >/dev/null 2>&1 && tesseract --version | head -1 || echo '未安装 Tesseract OCR'

status_check.name: 检查配置模板
status_check.command: [ -f "$HOME/.agent-s/agent-s.env" ] && echo '配置模板已创建' || echo '配置模板不存在'

notes: Agent-S 属于 GUI / Computer-Use Agent 框架，不是 IDE、MCP 或上下文优化工具。运行前需要配置主模型和 grounding model。官方支持启用本地代码执行，但该能力会执行 Python/Bash，建议只在隔离目录或虚拟机中手动开启。
